deploybot: PROD deploy started — env=prod-usw2, tag=v3.6.0-rc2, commit=`9f8a7b3d`, rollout=canary(5%->25%->100%), window=2026-03-21T22:00Z-23:00Z. Quick notes: no DB migrations, feature flags: seqlen-tune=on. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/inference/deploys/v3.6.0
jamie: ack. Kicking off smoke and canary checks. pinging @maya for observability monitors.
maya: watching metrics now. will call out if p50/p95 spike or error surge.
ops-bot: smoke-check result: OK. nginx 502s=0, request_rate stable, infra health=green.
liu: seeing a small uptick in 5xx on the embed service in the new canary pods — ~3% error rate over baseline. linking logs: https://logs.redwood/embed-canary/9f8a7b
ravi: thanks, @liu — can someone validate if this is request shaping/seqlen regression or real error?
jamie: pulling canary logs, reproducing locally against commit 9f8a7b3d. also temporarily pausing traffic increase.
deploybot: Rollout paused at 5% by jamie. Reason: embed /batch endpoint error increase. Canary frozen; rollback NOT initiated.
maya: confirmed spikes correlate with long-seq requests. p95 token latency +18% but error rate small.
liu: quick workaround candidate: disable seqlen-tune flag for canary via feature flags (ff:seqlen-tune=false). Can push patch and resume.
jamie: applying patch to canary (hotfix commit `c1d2e3f`). patch includes bounds check for sequence truncation.
ops-bot: canary hotfix deployed to 5% cluster — health checks re-running.
ops-bot: canary health: OK after hotfix. 5xx back to baseline, p95 latency within +3%.
jamie: resuming rollout. moving to 25% now.
deploybot: Rollout resumed -> 25% (automated step). Monitoring for 10m.
maya: metrics look steady at 25%. no errors. tracing shows the truncated sequences path exercised and OK.
jamie: proceeding to 100% in 10m if stable. leaving note to ops: pin this tag for 30m after full completion.
deploybot: Rollout advanced -> 100%. All shards migrated to tag v3.6.0-rc2.
deploybot: PROD deploy complete — tag=v3.6.0-rc2, commit=`9f8a7b3d` (hotfix applied `c1d2e3f`), duration=00:32:22, final-status=SUCCESS. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/inference/releases/v3.6.0
ravi: :tada: nice work, team. thanks for the fast patch and verification.
jamie: pinned tag in release tracker and created follow-up ticket for more robust seqlen tests.
maya: added perf regression alert to ci for embed path.
liu: noted for Optimize recommendations — may tighten batch size heuristics for long-seq workloads.
ops-bot: post-deploy checklist run: all items green. retention alerts none.
deploybot: Closing thread — feel free to open a follow-up if anything else appears. :shipit:
